Rights holder: Justin Brown
Metadata: caltech_images_20210113.json from https://storage.googleapis.com/public-datasets-lila/caltechcameratraps/labels/caltech_camera_traps.json.zip
Images: https://storage.googleapis.com/public-datasets-lila/caltech-unzipped/cct_images/<file>

Location
Locations ranked by the number of species with at least 5 independent detections (30-minute rule, per species), then by the share of photos taken between 20:00 and 06:00. Labels 'empty' and 'car' are not species. 1 photo(s) without a readable capture time were left out.

rank  location  species  night share  photos
   1        46       11        0.575    6035
   2       114       11        0.356   13157
   3       115        9        0.559    2651
   4        88        9        0.382    2962
   5       120        9        0.372    3066
   6        33        8        0.680    3928
   7       100        8        0.672    4752
   8        28        8        0.605    1271
   9       125        8        0.481    1645
  10        43        8        0.442    4058

Chosen: location 46, first in the ranking, with 11 species: opossum 329, bobcat 228, raccoon 156, rabbit 143, coyote 130, skunk 30, bird 24, rodent 14, cat 5, dog 5, squirrel 5 independent detections.

Selection
Whole camera bursts, spread over the location's dates in van der Corput order: empty bursts up to 12 photos, then one burst per species in turn, most detected species first, until 60 photos. Each species burst opens an independent detection and carries that one species label. Bursts labelled 'car' are excluded, and so are bursts missing frames: the dataset removed frames from some bursts, and one kept frame labelled empty showed a person. 60 photos, 15 taken at night.

Changes
Downsized to 1600 px on the long side and saved at JPEG quality 72. All metadata is removed except EXIF DateTimeOriginal, which holds the dataset's date_captured. File names are the dataset's.
